_doc: Advisories the shared Security workflow (ValentinTorassa/.github, scripts/npm-audit.mjs) reports as warnings instead of failing. Each entry needs id, package, added (YYYY-MM-DD) and reason. Remove an entry once a release without the advisory is in the lockfile; the script flags entries that no longer match anything.

allow.reason: Stack exhaustion on deeply nested brace patterns. No patched braces release exists (3.0.3, the latest, is affected). Here it is a devDependency only: eslint-config-next > @next/eslint-plugin-next > fast-glob > micromatch > braces, run by the linter over this repository's own files. It is not in the deployed app.
